t: This is Home House, a Grade One listed Georgian town house at 20 Portman Square in Marylebone, now a private members' club. It was designed by the architect James Wyatt, a rival of Robert Adam in the neoclassical style, and later president of the Royal Academy. It was commissioned by Elizabeth Home, Countess of Home, a Jamaican-born heiress who became a wealthy widow in London and lived here. Her wealth came partly from plantations in Jamaica, where she owned over four hundred enslaved people.
